text:
maya: Okay team — launch day is live! 🎉 Massive props to infra + QA. Quick poll: react with :+1: for stickers, :tshirt: for hoodies. Also thinking a midnight rooftop toast at 11pm? who’s in?

raj: Stickers pls!! my laptop needs branding 😅 :+1:

emma: Hoodie please — I need something to hide coffee stains in all our meetings :tshirt:

samir: Can we get both and let people trade? :)

ellie: I can print a tiny sticker design tonight if ops approves. vote: sticker design A vs B (A is cactus, B is tiny rocket).

milo: cactus > rocket. also dropping a celebratory gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/party-rocket-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40

olivia: Huge shoutout to @samir and @maya for holding the rollout during the late window. oncall heroics = 10/10 :heart:

deploy-bot: deploy-success — service: inference-api, version: v3.2.1, duration: 7m 12s, no rollback triggered

maya: Love the oncall shoutouts. Cake poll: chocolate, lemon, or nothing (i.e., more stickers). :cake:

raj: chocolate or I riot.

emma: lemon cake for the brave.

samir: I will bring the tiny confetti cannons. safety goggles recommended.

ellie: Sticker A (cactus) wins by 3. putting in art order.

milo: who wants to walk over to the roof at 11? i’ll bring thermos of tea and kazoo.

olivia: in if there’s hot chocolate.

maya: Rooftop plan: 11pm, roof access via north stairs, meet by the skylight. if you can't make it DM me for stash pickup tomorrow.

raj: tagging design: @ellie — can you also make a small version for laptops and a circle one for water bottles?

ellie: yep — two sizes. printing ETA tomorrow morning.

milo: also — low-key meme contest during toast. winner gets first hoodie.

samir: challenge accepted. i have one that will make maya snort-laugh.

olivia: reminder for folks remote: we’ll livestream the toast in #all-hands and drop a sticker/hoodie form after.

maya: thanks everyone. small checklist: 1) stickers ordered (ellie) 2) hoodies survey after thread (olivia) 3) rooftop 11pm (maya) 4) oncall kudos pinned to #announcements (olivia). proud of y’all :sparkles: :partyparrot:
